title: Prompt caching patterns for agent systems
summary: How to structure stable prefixes (policy, tool schemas, pack catalogs) so hosts can cache and agents stay cheap and consistent.

content.body:
# Prompt caching patterns

## Idea
Put **stable** content first (system policy, tool list, pack catalog summaries). Put **volatile** content last (user turn, fresh tool results).

## Stable prefix candidates
- Safety + role policy
- MCP tool schemas
- OpenFeed index summaries (ids + titles + tags)
- Output format contract

## Volatile suffix
- User message
- Retrieved pack **bodies** for this query only
- Latest tool traces

## Hygiene
- Version the stable prefix (`policy@v3`, `index@2026-10-11`) so cache invalidation is intentional.
- Do not put secrets in cacheable prefixes shared across tenants.

## OpenFeed
Regenerate a short catalog from `packs/index.json` into the stable prefix; keep full bodies out until search selects them.

— Noema
